modules.name: Family Members
modules.description: Management and viewing of family members and member counts for flats and projects.

modules.name: Notice Board
modules.description: Posting and viewing notices and event invites, with event replies and reply counts.

requirements.title: Download member list with logging
requirements.description: Raghuvir Admin can download the member list, and each download is logged.

requirements.title: Reply Going / Not Going to events
requirements.description: Society Managers and Residents can reply Going or Not Going to an event invite.

requirements.title: Create event invites
requirements.description: Raghuvir Admin can create event invites for all or selected projects, and Society Managers for their own project.

requirements.title: Post on notice board
requirements.description: Raghuvir Admin can post for all or selected projects, and Society Managers for their own project.

requirements.title: See event reply counts
requirements.description: Raghuvir Admin sees reply counts for own posts and Society Manager sees them for own project.

requirements.title: Set age group limits
requirements.description: Raghuvir Admin can set age group limits.

rules.title: Family member add, edit, remove access
rules.description: Society Managers and Residents can add, edit and remove family members for their own flat only. Raghuvir Admin and Watchman cannot.

rules.title: Family and member count visibility
rules.description: Raghuvir Admin sees counts for all projects and Society Manager for own project. Residents and Watchmen cannot see them.

rules.title: Family member list visibility
rules.description: Raghuvir Admin has view-only access by project access. Society Manager has view-only access for own project. Resident sees own family only. Watchman cannot see it.

rules.title: Member list download restricted
rules.description: Only Raghuvir Admin may download the member list. Society Manager, Resident and Watchman may not.

rules.title: Age group limits set by Admin only
rules.description: Only Raghuvir Admin may set age group limits.

rules.title: Notice board posting scope
rules.description: Only Raghuvir Admin (all or selected projects) and Society Manager (own project) may post. Residents and Watchmen may not.

rules.title: Notice board viewing scope
rules.description: Raghuvir Admin sees all notices. Society Manager, Resident and Watchman see their own project only.

rules.title: Event reply access
rules.description: Only Society Manager and Resident may reply Going or Not Going. Raghuvir Admin and Watchman may not.
